scope: Entire program-assisted workflow versus original full skill with the same read-only source tools, model, facts, source and purpose limits; not an isolated DSL representation effect.

quality.unit: Each of the original four questions, assessed from the full delivered answer against unchanged source-completeness requirements
quality.report: Keep each improvement, tie and regression; never substitute field matches for natural answer quality.

confirmationEligibility.quality: At least one original question has a higher source-reviewed category in C0 than B0; report any regressions separately.
confirmationEligibility.cost: Alternatively C0 observed input plus output is strictly lower than B0 with both usage records available; input already includes cache-read once.
confirmationEligibility.required: No unrepaired shared implementation defect and current closed delivered C0 eligible for previous consumption.

secondPair: If eligible, C1 then B1 on empty-version, same implementation epoch; no third pair.
positiveBoundary: Only both pairs preserve all four quality categories and lower total observed input plus output permit the bounded two-pair positive observation. Authoring/repair/maintenance and preparation are separately included in amortization; USD and human cost remain unknown.
